metadata.question: Were there more fire events detected with the VIIRS sensors in the southern Brazilian Amazon in 2020 than in 2019?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use NOAA VIIRS VNP14A1 daily thermal anomalies (1 km) for 2019 and 2020. Region = intersection of Brazil boundary and a bounding box approximating the southern Brazilian Amazon (lon: -74 to -47, lat: -18 to -5). Count annual fire pixel-days (sum of daily detections across pixels).
2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking (fire product). Treat detections as MaxFRP > 0. Count valid pixel-days using the band mask to detect C2.
3. Valid zero vs. null: If collection size is 0 => C1. If valid pixel-days == 0 with images present => C2. If any result is null/NaN => C3.
</thinking>

const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const brazil = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level0')
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Brazil'))
      .geometry();
    const southernBox = ee.Geometry.Rectangle({coords: [-74, -18, -47, -5], geodesic: false});
    const region = brazil.intersection(southernBox, 1);
    const regionAreaKm2 = await region.area(1).divide(1e6).getInfo();
    console.log(`Region area (km^2): ${regionAreaKm2.toFixed(0)}`);

    const dataset = 'NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14A1';

    async function yearStats(year) {
      const start = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 1, 1);
      const end = start.advance(1, 'year');
      let col = ee.ImageCollection(dataset).filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(region);
      const size = await col.size().getInfo();
      if (size === 0) {
        // Recovery attempt: widen by 15 days on each side
        const start2 = start.advance(-15, 'day');
        const end2 = end.advance(15, 'day');
        col = ee.ImageCollection(dataset).filterDate(start2, end2).filterBounds(region);
      }
      const size2 = await col.size().getInfo();
      if (size2 === 0) return {year, images: 0, fire: null, valid: null, code: 'C1'};

      const binCol = col.map(img => {
        const frp = img.select('MaxFRP');
        const fire = frp.gt(0).rename('fire');
        const valid = frp.mask().rename('valid'); // 1 where data is valid
        return fire.addBands(valid);
      });

      const summed = binCol.sum(); // sums across days: per-pixel fire-days and valid-days
      const totals = await summed.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e13,
        tileScale: 2
      }).getInfo();

      const fireSum = totals ? totals.fire : null;
      const validSum = totals ? totals.valid : null;

      if (fireSum === null || validSum === null || isNaN(fireSum) || isNaN(validSum)) {
        return {year, images: size2, fire: fireSum, valid: validSum, code: 'C3'};
      }
      if (validSum === 0) {
        return {year, images: size2, fire: fireSum, valid: validSum, code: 'C2'};
      }
      return {year, images: size2, fire: fireSum, valid: validSum, code: null};
    }

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    const s2019 = await yearStats(2019);
    const s2020 = await yearStats(2020);

    // Handle error codes
    const codes = [s2019.code, s2020.code].filter(c => c !== null);
    if (codes.length > 0) {
      // Print minimal diagnostics then final code (first priority)
      if (s2019.code) console.log(`2019: Images=${s2019.images} Code=${s2019.code}`);
      else console.log(`2019: Images=${s2019.images} Fire=${Math.round(s2019.fire)} Valid=${Math.round(s2019.valid)}`);
      if (s2020.code) console.log(`2020: Images=${s2020.images} Code=${s2020.code}`);
      else console.log(`2020: Images=${s2020.images} Fire=${Math.round(s2020.fire)} Valid=${Math.round(s2020.valid)}`);
      console.log(codes[0]); // C1 or C2 or C3
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing & Validation
    const rate2019 = s2019.fire / s2019.valid;
    const rate2020 = s2020.fire / s2020.valid;

    // 4. Evidence output (concise)
    console.log(`2019 Images: ${s2019.images}; ValidPixDays: ${Math.round(s2019.valid)}; FireDetections: ${Math.round(s2019.fire)}; Rate: ${rate2019.toFixed(6)}`);
    console.log(`2020 Images: ${s2020.images}; ValidPixDays: ${Math.round(s2020.valid)}; FireDetections: ${Math.round(s2020.fire)}; Rate: ${rate2020.toFixed(6)}`);
    console.log(`ΔFireDetections (2020-2019): ${Math.round(s2020.fire - s2019.fire)}`);

    // 5. Final Answer
    if (!isFinite(s2019.fire) || !isFinite(s2020.fire)) {
      console.log('C3');
    } else if (s2020.fire > s2019.fire) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
